title: When you want your life to become seva
issueStatement: You want your life to be useful, but service can easily harden into spiritual performance or burnout.
centralInsight: Guru joins seva with humility, obedience, hiddenness, and remembrance. Seva is not just effort. It is a spiritual way of being.
practicalReflection: Useful work without inner alignment can harden the self; nishkaam seva softens and reorders it.
actionPrompt: Choose one act of service today that is faithful, sustainable, and not secretly hungry for praise.

source.shortMeaning: Hiddenness and reward-free service define true seva.
source.lifeApplication: Seva is not self-display with religious vocabulary.

excerpts.explanation: This is the clearest direct line in the catalog on nishkaam seva.

source.shortMeaning: Honest work and giving are part of the path itself.
source.lifeApplication: Seva is not separate from how you earn and share.

excerpts.explanation: Guru Nanak gives seva concrete ethical shape.

source.shortMeaning: Human life is an opportunity for meeting and holy company.
source.lifeApplication: Seva makes sense when life is understood as purposeful gift.

excerpts.explanation: Purpose and seva strengthen each other in this framing.
